text:
sasha: quick heads-up — brought up marlin-lite-v2 in staging and ran recall+k + clustering checks; seeing a weird shard density gap.

mike: gap how? numbers or plot?

sasha: shard A avg_norm 0.87, shard B 0.43; silhouette dropped 0.62 -> 0.48 on short queries.

jordana: could be tokenization/normalization mismatch during offline build (we saw whitespace handling cause this before).

priyanka: check nn distance dist k=10, long tail can inflate avg norms.

(eval-bot): quick eval: recall@1=0.71, recall@10=0.92, mean_cosine_shardA=0.86, mean_cosine_shardB=0.44, silhouette=0.49. report: https://ci/reports/4456789012/marlin-lite-v2

sasha: re-ran with prod preprocessing -> gap persists. sample by length: short(<128) recall@1=0.74, mid=0.69, long(>1024)=0.61. shardB aligns with long docs.

mike: share failure samples? maybe domain- or lang-specific.

sasha: sampling shows 8/50 failures where top1 swapped with semantically unrelated doc — looks like collapse for a subdomain.

jordana: run spectral-gap on affinity matrix; command I use: 
```
python eval/embed_diag.py --model marlin-lite-v2 --dataset staging-sample --metrics recall silhouette spectral_gap --k 10
```

priyanka: try whitening + L2 norm before KNN; last time whiten=True,l2norm=True reduced shard effects on mixed domains.

mike: was this run quantized? per-channel vs per-tensor quant can shift norms.

sasha: fp16 baseline. planning int4-perchannel and int4-pertensor next.

(eval-bot): queued job 4456789123: quant runs scheduled on gpu-pool-staging. ETA ~20m.

jordana: when reporting recall delta, use bootstrap (n=500) for CIs. short tails flip numbers.

(eval-bot): quant results: int4-perchannel recall@1=0.69 (-0.02), recall@10=0.90 (-0.02), silhouette=0.45 (-0.04). int4-pertensor recall@1=0.66 (-0.05), recall@10=0.88 (-0.04), silhouette=0.40 (-0.09). artifacts: https://ci/reports/4456789123/quant-compare

jordana: per-channel looks acceptable; per-tensor much worse -> prefer per-channel if we compress.

priyanka: also add cross-lingual holdout check — quant can amplify non-en idiosyncrasies.

mike: proposal: 1) run whitening+L2 + int4-perchannel 2) spectral-gap + bootstrap CIs 3) top-1 pairwise diffs for ~200 failure candidates 4) holdout multilanguage subset.

sasha: kicking off 1 & 2 now, longer run for 3. will post UMAP and pairwise diffs. tl;dr: marlin-lite-v2 staging has shard density gap; int4-perchannel promising; whitening+L2norm is first mitigation to test. :white_check_mark:
